[SWS_CORE_10103] Creation of ara::core::Byte instances
⌈
An instance of type
ara::core::Byte shall be creatable from an integral type with brace-initialization
syntax.
This initialization shall also be possible when called in a constant expres-
sion. If the initializer value is outside the value range of type ara::core::Byte (see
[SWS_CORE_10102]), the behavior is undefined.
⌋
